mechanisms.decisive_claim: The least r with n*r!<=k^(r+theta) satisfies r<=(c+epsilon)log(k)/loglog(k) uniformly up to n=exp(c log(k)^2/loglog(k)).
mechanisms.kill_test: Retain log(r!) exactly enough to test whether it is lower-order uniformly at the endpoint.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: sharpened least-order lemma with r<=(c+epsilon)log(k)/loglog(k).

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A deliberately non-balanced lambda makes both first Theorem 4.1 terms smaller in the leading exponent than the source balance.
mechanisms.kill_test: Multiply the powered terms and solve the exact minimax problem over lambda.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: the exact A--B product invariant rules out a leading c-frontier gain from non-balanced lambda. evidence/adaptive_unbalanced_partition_frontier.md records the distinct author-level gain: unbalancing removes the balanced additive theta>9/23 endpoint without changing c*(theta).

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The source balanced lambda is exponent-optimal for fixed r and yields A=B=k^(-(1-theta)/(3r-2)).
mechanisms.kill_test: Verify lambda>=1 at the least r and recompute both substitutions exactly.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md and evidence/frontier_algebra_replay.json: exact balanced substitution.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The third Konyagin term imposes the genuine frontier c<1/12 after sharpening r.
mechanisms.kill_test: Insert r~c log(k)/loglog(k) and the exact minimality bound for lambda instead of k^(-1/(6r)).
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: exact third-term decay is log^(-1/(2c)+o(1)); 1/12 is coarse.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The additive r*lambda term imposes a new c-dependent restriction inside 2/5<theta<3/5.
mechanisms.kill_test: Maximize its exact k-exponent over all integer r>=3 and compare it to theta.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: the balanced additive exponent decreases from r=3 and remains below theta in the frozen range. evidence/adaptive_unbalanced_partition_frontier.md supersedes any architecture-wide endpoint reading by proving an author-level adaptive lambda bound for every fixed theta>0.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Taking r asymptotically larger than the least admissible value improves the third term enough to improve the overall c frontier.
mechanisms.kill_test: Track how larger r changes the A--B minimax exponent and compare the two constraints.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: larger r worsens the active A--B minimax exponent.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Summing finitely or polylogarithmically many comparable independent prime blocks improves the leading c(theta) frontier.
mechanisms.kill_test: Normalize prime supply and Theorem 4.1 error per block; test whether the common A--B lower envelope cancels in the ratio.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: independent comparable blocks scale error and prime supply equally. evidence/location_blind_subdivision_bridge.md and evidence/source_geometry_uniform_losses.md extend the scoped obstruction to arbitrary finite k-dependent nonuniform partitions of the deterministic PI tail under explicit common raw constants a,En,ED, location-blind coverage, and a termwise nonnegative little-o ledger; formal/ParametricRanges.lean kernel-checks the finite map to C=-log(a), D=5/2+En+ED.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Using a longer prime block beta>theta improves the leading c(theta) frontier.
mechanisms.kill_test: Replace theta by beta in both the divisibility threshold and A--B product and optimize beta.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: beta>theta changes the candidate frontier to the smaller (1-beta)/3.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The PI(theta) count can be subdivided into shorter beta<theta blocks with enough guaranteed primes to improve the frontier.
mechanisms.kill_test: Check the quantifiers of PI(theta); construct distributions of the guaranteed primes concentrated in one subblock.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/frontier_falsification.md: PI(theta) has no shorter-subblock count consequence.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every 2/5<theta<3/5 satisfying PI(theta) and every c<(1-theta)/3, the full source range proof yields p in (k,k+3k^theta), hence in (k,2k) for large k.
mechanisms.kill_test: Adversarially replay all four n ranges, lambda>=1, r constraints, bounded r, and the final interval embedding.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/parametric_frontier_proof.md, Theorem A; adversarial_self_audit.md. Author-verified natural proof, independent audit pending.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: No proof in the delimited termwise blockwise Theorem 4.1 little-o certificate class can reach c>=(1-theta)/3.
mechanisms.kill_test: Attempt non-balanced lambda, variable r, comparable multiblocks, and the equality endpoint; reject any argument that confuses a lower bound on the certificate with a lower bound on the true K.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/parametric_frontier_proof.md, Theorem B, and adversarial_self_audit.md prove the audited delimited termwise barrier. evidence/location_blind_subdivision_bridge.md, evidence/source_geometry_uniform_losses.md, and formal/ParametricRanges.lean give the author-audited finite location-blind deterministic-tail extension and map explicit common raw constants a,En,ED to uniform losses C=-log(a), D=5/2+En+ED; arbitrary regroupings remain outside unless they prove those constants.
